capabilities: Summarize the active Markdown note with an AI model
Write the recap into the note's Properties as a summary field
Test the API connection with a short test message
Customize the prompt template and output schema
Configure model and endpoint, including custom OpenAI-compatible providers
disambiguation: Not a journaling or daily-notes tool; it only adds an AI-generated summary property to an existing note.
extras: Desktop only. The Test API call makes a real billed request. The API key is stored in vault plugin data, so vault files should be treated as private when sharing or syncing. Custom providers must support the Responses API and structured outputs; Chat Completions alone is not enough.
intentEvidence: Journal Recap is based on Auto Classifier by Hyeonseo Nam.
problem: Long journal entries are hard to revisit later because nothing in the note gives a quick reminder of what mattered that day.

summary: AI summarizer that writes a one-sentence recap of the active journal entry into the note's Properties under a summary field.
